description: Fast local file discovery, trigram-indexed source search, and smart block-clamped context cache for AI coding agents (VS Code Native Language Model Tools & MCP server in Rust).
rules: Use #cctxNativeContext (or MCP code_context) first to search and fetch surrounding source in one call instead of separate grep and file-read calls.
Use #cctxNativeFiles (or MCP code_files) for filename/path glob discovery, never content patterns.
Content search in code_grep and code_context is literal by default; set regex=true for alternation (a|b) or regular expressions.

Treat CACHE_MISS as an immediate nonblocking cache miss that queues background loading for that root; fall back to permitted host search/read for that lookup without polling or calling code_sync to wait.
Use max_matches_per_file in code_grep or code_context to cap noisy files and prioritize symbol definitions (fn, struct, class, def, interface).
